name: 덤불박쥐
appearance: Leaf-eared dark plum bat with a moss-green belly, membranous wings and one pair of bright eyes; small low fluttering silhouette.

motions.stand: Hovering in place, both membrane wings fold upward then fan fully open and close, ears twitch, one gentle wingbeat cycle returning to the exact ready pose. Real hinged wing articulation, not sprite translation.
motions.move: Low flying rush toward the left in place, alternating broad upstroke and forceful downstroke, body pitches forward then levels, legs tuck, head and leaf ears remain facing left. A continuous wingbeat locomotion loop without moving the whole sprite across the canvas.
motions.attack1: Facing left, crouch the airborne body and draw both wings backward, then thrust the head and small open fangs sharply forward left with the wings sweeping forward, retract and return to ready hovering pose. One clear diving bite, no extra enemies or effects.
motions.hit1: Facing left, wince from a strike on the face, fold one wing close and recoil the shoulders back to the right, then reopen both wings and return to the original hover. Visible reaction in face, wings and legs.
motions.die1: Facing left, lose wing tension, fold both membrane wings inward, descend and topple onto the side, ears droop and eyes close, finish motionless on the ground. Do not dissolve or revive.
